title: Pan-Seared Squid with Peppercorn Crust
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring pan-seared squid with a crunchy peppercorn crust.
instructions: Rinse the squid tubes under cold water, pat dry with paper towels.
Season the squid with salt and set aside.
Grind the black peppercorns into a fine powder using a spice grinder or mortar and pestle.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the skillet and swirl to coat.
Sear the squid tubes for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the squid to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Reduce heat to medium and add the minced garlic and sliced jalapeño peppers to the skillet.
Cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Sprinkle the ground black peppercorns over the garlic and peppers.
Toss to combine and cook for an additional minute.
Serve the squid tubes with the peppercorn crust spooned over the top.
